title: Classification of globally periodic rational difference equations
abstract: A complete classification of the globally periodic rational difference equations x_{n+K} = (A_0 + A_1 x_n + ... + A_K x_{n+K-1}) / (B_0 + B_1 x_n + ... + B_K x_{n+K-1}) with nonnegative coefficients, acting on positive initial data, answering Problem 11 of Gasull's survey of open problems in low-dimensional dynamical systems. Such an equation is globally periodic (every positive solution satisfies x_{n+p} = x_n for a common p >= 1) if and only if, up to rescaling x_n -> alpha x_n and unfolding (multiplying every index by an integer), it is one of the five known examples: x_{n+1} = x_n, x_{n+1} = 1/x_n, x_{n+2} = x_{n+1}/x_n, the Lyness equation x_{n+2} = (1 + x_{n+1})/x_n, and Todd's period-8 equation x_{n+3} = (1 + x_{n+1} + x_{n+2})/x_n. The result holds at every order K. Previously the question had been settled for K in {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11} (Cima, Gasull and Mañosas 2004) and for some special families, but the general case was open.
